dogecoin.text:
Elon Musk took the stage again by announcing a mission to the moon funded by $Doge, on May 9th - DOGE-1 Mission to the Moon. #DogecoinToTheMoon.
Today, it stands at $0.3707, after a fall of roughly 40% since the announcement. https://t.co/PubmAFrwh6

In Feb '21, $Doge hit a high of $0.08 due to encouragement from Musk, Snoop Dogg and others. Further, in March, #MarkCuban announced that tickets to games could be bought in Dogecoin. Within 2 days, the #Mavericks had become the top merchant for Doge, with 20,000 transactions.
In January 2021, #Dogecoin jumped more than 800% in a DAY, due to attention from #Reddit users – which stemmed from #ElonMusk’s encouragement as well as the #GameStop short squeeze.

During the #CryptoBubble of 2017-18, #Dogecoin reached a peak of $0.017 on 7th January 2018 and a market cap of almost $2 billion. 

Later in July 2020, $Doge prices SPIKED due to a #TikTok trend, which aimed at making the coin reach $1.
In January 2014, the trading volume of $Doge became higher than #Bitcoin  as well as ALL other cryptos for a period of time. However, the market cap was far behind that of $BTC.

A thread through the 8 years of #Dogecoin  – from a joke to holding the 6th largest market cap among cryptos. 💸 But how did the coin that started as a meme reach a market cap of over $50 billion dollars? 🧐 https://t.co/0Wxlqlz5gt

If you have invested $1000 in #Dogecoin $DOGE just a year ago, you would have had $121207.57 in your pocket! 🥵

A return rate of 12,020.757%!! 💀Now that's astronomical! https://t.co/dVfhRROmmb
